metadata.description:
https://logbot.info IRC Logs Archive

Description from https://archive.logbot.info/:

LogBot was an IRC logging bot I ran for just under 17 years.
LogBot was completely decommissioned in mid June 2021.
Archives of the logs can be found below.

Mozilla: ~16,853,000 events over 148 channels
FreeNode: ~8,217,000 events over 149 channels
W3C: ~617,000 over 6 channels
